title: Nvidia Shares Fall Amid Investigation
excerpt: Nvidia shares dropped significantly following an investigation regarding an affair involving Huang and an alleged Chinese spy.
body_html:
Nvidia's share price recently experienced a significant drop, wiping hundreds of billions of dollars from the total market value of the company.

The decline followed an investigation into an affair involving Huang and an alleged Chinese spy. Further details regarding the ongoing probe and its potential impacts on the firm remain limited at this time.
